evidence: The routine loads a player-attribute record through its context lookup, calls player_attribute_get_float with selector 0x57, and stores the returned scalar float to the caller-provided output pointer. If the initial record lookup is null it invokes the fallback helper before the same selector read. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:35868-35888.

Initializes the output to zero, resolves a nested attribute provider through the context lookup, reads selector 0x1e with nested_attribute_provider_get_float, converts the returned float to signed int, and stores that integer to the output pointer. If the provider context is absent, it leaves the output zero. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:29088-29112.

The body checks a pointer field, status byte/word conditions, and the accepted check_attribute_status_0_is_2 predicate, then tail-calls an address-only helper with a constant float argument. The unknown helper result semantics prevent a useful behavior name. decompiled/main/main_0120.c:11216-11238.

Obtains a valid status-9 context, queries its index 2 value, and writes zero unless both that value and the global context value at offset 0x62e4 are at least 1. When both pass, converts them to floats and stores value_at_0x62e4 divided by index_2_value. The consumer-visible domain is unknown, so the name describes only the proven ratio. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:32225-32242.

Initializes/obtains a context value and stores the helper result to the output pointer. It then reads attribute-context selector 0x13; when its status is 7, it overwrites the output with UINT32_MAX (-1). decompiled/main/main_0124.c:20752-20766.
